title: A sale Frequency introduced costs one finder's fee, 10% and never more than $20, on the customer's first purchase only

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18: "I like the no take rate for your own people thing" then "make all the changes site wide to the new system" (project thread: Rethink our take rates). ADR-1978. Pin rewrites approved by the owner 2026-11-18 ("Yes, all groups in the doc").

detail: The fee on a sale the network sourced was a ladder by plan (Business 5%, Collective 3%, Network 2%) with no cap, charged again on a repeat shop, booking or donation buyer because only a past TICKET counted as bought before, and charged on every renewal of a membership because a subscription carries its fee as a recurring percent. DONE 2026-11-19: one finder's fee for every plan but Non Profit (lib/billing/pricing-keys.ts FINDERS_FEE_BPS_DEFAULT 1000, FINDERS_FEE_CAP_CENTS_DEFAULT 2000, held by capFindersFeeCents in every fee path), stored as take_rate.finder_bps and finder_cap_cents and editable at /admin/pricing. No migration: the 5 / 3 row migration 20270346005300 stored is still in production and is simply no longer read. A buyer with any past paid ticket, order, donation or paid membership with the seller is the seller's own (lib/commerce/seller-audience.ts), so the fee fires once. A membership checkout marks a fee-bearing join and the invoice.paid webhook drops the percent after the first invoice (lib/billing/membership-finders-fee.ts), leaving only the card fee once that passes through. A Founding Business keeps its locked 3%. Probes LIVE-754 and SCAN-956 were rewritten to the new rule. Known limits: an order shared between sellers counts as a past purchase for its first seller only, and a membership bought before this change keeps its recurring percent until it is renewed by hand or re-bought (production has no paid memberships as of 2026-11-18). Marketing and help copy that still quotes 5 / 3 / 2 in words follows in the copy rows.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
